name: Green River (Dinosaur National Monument)
blurb: Canyon of Lodore, Whirlpool and Split Mountain canyons in Dinosaur National Monument. NPS permit required for every trip.

sections.notes: NPS multiday permit (lottery; $185 + $15 application). Starts in Colorado. NPS: 44 miles; 'Normal trip lengths are 4 days (3 nights) on the Green River' in high-use season. Gauge at Jensen is downstream of the Yampa confluence (Echo Park); Lodore Canyon flow is roughly the Greendale release.

guideTimes.conditions: Normal Green River high-use-season trip length in the 2025 NPS regulations: four days, three nights. This is a permitted itinerary, not hours afloat. Check current permit conditions.
guideTimes.sourceName: NPS Boating in the Monument, 2025 regulations

putInAccess.sourceName: NPS Public POIs, OBJECTID 10790 'Lodore Boat Launch' (DINO)
putInAccess.note: NPS Public POIs, OBJECTID 10790 'Lodore Boat Launch' (DINO) is the managing agency's own point. Legal boating access: NPS Dinosaur NM: Boating and Rafting Permits (https://www.nps.gov/dino/planyourvisit/boating-and-rafting.htm): 'Green River multiday permits start at Gates of Lodore Boat Ramp and end at Split Mountain Boat Ramp.' Permits required for all river trips in the monument. Imagery: Esri World Imagery z19 checked 2026-10-25 (research/raw/imagery/gates_of_lodore_boat_ramp.png): the point is on the launch-area road about 35-40 m east of the gravel launch beach, beside the ranger-station rigging area (similar to accepted WA ramp-lane points). NHD flowline 58 m away. Located in Colorado (cross-state endpoint of a Utah-catalog river).
putInAccess.bankSourceName: USGS NHD High Resolution flowline (flow-direction digitized) + Esri World Imagery
putInAccess.bankNote: Facing downstream (flow bearing ~187), the point is left of the NHD centreline (58 m).
